prompts.prompt: Horizontal 3:2 photorealistic editorial DIY gift-wrapping still life in a modest warm American home. Nearby a second neatly folded cream cloth square and a blank kraft gift tag, no ribbon or paper wrapping, no extra decorative clutter. Natural window light, realistic woven fabric texture and clean folded box corners, cozy restrained interior softly out of focus. No people, writing, logos, watermark or text overlay.
